summary: Tested source on/off toggles (CasparCG/vMix/OnTheAir) end-to-end. Backend: new tests/test_sources.py (8 tests) + regression test_ota.py (16) -> 24/24 pass when run serially. Verified: GET /api/status & /api/settings include sources; casparcg off -> osc.listening=false, back on -> true; PUT without 'sources' keeps current sources; ota off -> all 3 outputs connected=false and stay false (no polling) in both API and HyperDeck modes, back on -> reconnect; vmix off -> vmix.connected=false; invalid source type -> 422. Frontend: Settings 'Surse active' toggles show aria-pressed + Pornit/Oprit, last active source cannot be turned off, saving persists across reload, status dots hide for disabled sources. With CasparCG+vMix off: only switch-ota + gear shown, / and /vmix redirect to /ota, /ota shows 3 outputs connected with clips/timers; 'Inapoi la timer' link also ends on /ota. With OTA off: switch-ota hidden, /ota -> /, status shows ota connected=[false,false,false]. Regression: HyperDeck/REST API mode switch via UI still 3/3 connected, OSC 'Asculta'. Settings restored to defaults at end (all sources on, api mode, 8081-8083, vmix 172.16.50.25:8088, osc 7250, channels 1/10 2/10).

minor.issue: Backend accepts sources all false (200). Only the UI prevents turning off all 3; an API client could disable every source. Consider a 422 (or forcing casparcg on) server-side.

action_items: Optional: reject sources all-false in put_settings (server-side validation matching the UI rule)
critical_code_review_comments: SourceSwitcher fetches /api/settings only on mount; fine since every page remounts it, but it could instead use 'sources' from the existing websocket state to react live to changes from another client.
Settings status dots use unsaved form.sources (hide as soon as toggled, before save) - acceptable but slightly inconsistent with backend state.
Tests share global backend state: running test_ota.py and test_sources.py in parallel (xdist default) causes interference; run with -n 0.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_ota.py (removed None from invalid ota_mode params: ota_mode is Optional by design, null keeps current mode)
seed_data_creation: None. Settings modified during tests and restored to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests serially: pytest tests/test_ota.py tests/test_sources.py -n 0. Mocks on 8081-8083 (REST) and 9993-9995 (HyperDeck). test_sources.py autouse fixture restores defaults with all sources on.
